If you didn't see my first post about this over here, it was just a little rage about these gravy-bloods in EB Games. Here's the full story. It's a long one, so buckle up shitlords.

So, it's a nice day. My girlfriend and I decide to go to the local mall. It's an outdoor mall with arcades, plazas, stores, and shopping centers. In one of these is an EB Games. That's where we were when we ran into an old friend of hers from high school. Being that we've met before and she's kind of obnoxious, I knew they'd be a while, so once I'd fulfilled my boyfriendly duty of smiling politely for long enough, I excused myself, and ducked into EB Games just to poke around. I didn't have the express purpose of buying something in particular, so I started browsing through one of the discount bins. After flicking past the eleventh second hand copy of FIFA '13, I saw them come in. Let's meet the fat fucks, shall we?

Neckfat: 5'6", and at least 280. He's your cookie cutter neckbeard. Unwashed, malodorous, greasy hair, and wearing cargo shorts with a wallet chain. I shit you not, he was wearing a fedora. But not just any fedora, oh no. It's got a Monster Energy patch on it. I could smell him from across the store, and he smelled like bacon bits and entitlement.

M'ladyfat: 5'2" and easily over 300 lb. Faded pink hair, some kind of lolita looking frilly skirt, a pink and black checkered fedora with a skull wearing a bow on it, and a vest straining against her chest flab that had either a cum stain or a mayo stain on it. Lovely. The fedora looked to be for a ten year old girl who can't know better, and was balanced on top of her greasy head with what she no doubt imagined was the classy panache of a novelty sized hat that a woman might wear to a day at the races.

I've never seen neckbeards in the wild before, much less one with a girlfriend who was also wearing a goddamn fucking fedora. But I left my disgust and incredulity to a head shake and a snort of laughter, and went back to flipping through the games. Within minutes, they waddled over to the bin, and Neckfat had a smug smirk plastered over his slightly glistening maw. I looked up, and before I could say anything, he takes a rattling breath through his mouth, and says the following in what seemed to be an impression of a stereotypical jock.

"Hey, bro. Looking for the latest Call of Duty or Madden?" I raised a brow, while M'ladyfat snickered behind her hand in what I can only assume was a grotesque attempt to be cute. I gave nothing but a blunt "no" and went back to ignoring them. He puffed out his moobs, still looking infuriatingly smug. What he said next threw me for a loop, purely because of the sheer stupidity. I couldn't believe I wasn't on the internet.

"You know, this really isn't a place for you. You should probably leave."

When I finally stopped internally reeling from the bafflement, I just gave him a "really?" look before responding.

"This public place isn't for me, a resident of the city, to be in. Seriously." At that, he shook his head. The spare tire under his chin rippled. He was already starting to look angry.

"Yeah bro (He seemed to consider the use of 'bro' an insult). You don't fucking belong here, alright? You think you're better than me?" Why he asked this, I have no idea, but before I could reign the shitlord in, I answered with a shrug.

"Well, yeah, but not for whatever reason you're probably thinking of." Normally I'm not the sort of guy who shitlords to people's faces, much less in public, but apparently browsing FPH before you go out is a recipe for making it happen. The second I said this, M'ladyfat promptly stopped giggling and started glaring at me in a way that suggested she was somehow summoning a bunch of fellow fats through telepathy to stampede the store and trample me. With that one sentence, Neckfat went livid, stomping his foot like a child, and pointing at me with spittle flying from his mouth. It was at this point that I realized he was probably mentally unstable. Either that or really easily offended.

"Fuck you, fuck you! I'm tired of thin pretty boys coming here, and coming into video games, and pretending like they're into it! Jocks don't like real games! They aren't even gamers! You're not a gamer! This place?" to emphasize his point here, he waved his flabby arms like a windmill, knocking his girlfriend's fedora off; it took everything in me not to burst out laughing as it flew a couple of feet away "This is our place! Our shrine! Not yours! Okay? You can stand there, and be all like "ooh, I'm a thin nerdy hipster guy and I like video games, I'm sooo alternative! But you can do things we can't! I can't play sports! Why don't you go out and play some real fucking football, or go back to the fucking gym! You don't need games! We do! Get the fuck out of here!"

I don't know what the fuck I'm wearing out and about to constitute being called a jock and a hipster in one sentence. I guess the fact that I'm in good shape and wear glasses is throwing off his calibrations here. In any case, once he finished his sudden little outburst, he was woefully out of breath, beet red, and glaring at me. M'ladyfat still hadn't picked up her fedora from the floor. Finally, she pipes up.

"Guys like you are why gamergate happened!"

I just stared blankly at them, unable to actually comprehend that these were words I was hearing come out of a subhuman's mouth, in front of my face, in the real world. Not on the internet. Neckfat steps forward while I'm still completely baffled, and tries to grab my jacket with one of his greasy ham hocks, like he's about to drag me out of the store. Lucky for him (I'm not prone to violence, but I was about to punch him in his yellowy beetus-teeth) the manager comes over, almost as livid as Neckfat. He shouts an outburst at them, while surrounding customers shrink away from the awkwardness, or just gawp openly in rubber-necked shock. Apparently, this isn't the first time Neckfat has screeched this type of speech at a guy in this store, and the manager is sick of it. He basically tells them to get the hell out and never come back because they're banned. M'ladyfat openly starts to bawl, and Neckfat's lower lip looks to be trembling. They waddle out at top speed (for them) even forgetting M'ladyfat's charming checkered fedora. Everyone just kind of went back to what they were doing, some giggling behind their hands with one another.

The manager apologized for what had happened, and asked if I was alright. At this point, I was still pissed off that it even happened, but it wasn't the manager's fault. I told him I was fine, and he compensated me with a twenty dollar store credit. Once he squared that away, he went out the back of the store again, and I posted my angry little post on FPH, and went back to browsing. But as I was flipping through yet more cases in the discount bin, the anger ebbed away, and I realized just how fucking funny the whole thing had been. By the time I took my purchase to the register (The Fallout trilogy, the first and second games, plus Tactics) I was almost laughing. This fat little fuck had been so worked up over my appearance and existence that he actually got himself banned from the store that he called his "shrine". I went back out to my girlfriend, who was still talking to her friend a few stores down, with a shitlord-eating grin (get it, instead of shit-eating? Eh? Ehhhh? -crickets-) on my face. And you know what?

I stepped on the fedora on my way out.
